errors.evidence: The chart uses fractions out of 38 (e.g., 15/38), not percentages. 15/38 ≈ 39.5%, not 15%. The description conflates counts with percentages.

errors.text_span: "Draft/Other" accounts for roughly 9% and is colored orange
errors.evidence: Draft/Other is 9/38 ≈ 23.7%, not 9%. Also, Draft/Other is colored dark red/crimson, not orange.

errors.text_span: "External News Article" constitutes approximately 15% of the total, depicted in a light teal color
errors.evidence: External News Article is shown in dark green, not light teal.

errors.text_span: "Article" represents 5% of the total and is shown in purple
errors.evidence: There is no category called 'Article' in the chart. The chart contains 'Intra-agency news article (1/38)' and 'Press Release (4/38)' among other categories. This appears to be a hallucinated category.

errors.text_span: "Article" represents 5% of the total and is shown in purple
errors.evidence: There is no 'Article' category in the figure. The model invented this category.

errors.text_span: "Email" comprises approximately 5% and is colored magenta
errors.evidence: Email (5/38) is colored in a dark brownish-red/maroon, not magenta.

errors.text_span: "Organizational Report" accounts for 2% and is presented in dark blue
errors.evidence: Organizational Report (2/38) appears in a light pink/lavender color, not dark blue. Dark blue is used for Interview.

errors.text_span: "Interview" represents approximately 2% and is colored grey
errors.evidence: Interview (2/38) appears in dark navy blue, not grey.
The description omits two visible categories: 'Press Release (4/38)' shown in yellow/gold and 'Intra-agency news article (1/38)' shown in orange.

errors.text_span: The chart contains nine slices, representing nine categories of stimuli.
errors.evidence: The chart shows eight categories/slices, not nine: External News Article, Draft/Other, Email, Organizational Report, Interview, Press Release, Intra-agency news article, and possibly one more — but the description lists only 6 named categories while claiming nine.

errors.text_span: The chart includes percentage labels displayed within each slice
errors.evidence: The chart labels are displayed outside the slices as text annotations, not inside the slices. Also, the labels show counts (e.g., 15/38) not percentage labels.

errors.text_span: The segments appear ordered from largest to smallest in terms of size
errors.evidence: The segments do not appear to be strictly ordered from largest to smallest going around the donut chart.
